decision.q: Does the AI decide for me?
decision.a: No. Interw transcribes each interview, compares it against the criteria you set and tells you which candidates to meet first. That's it. Every score is backed by a specific moment in the interview, one click away. You decide who you meet — and nothing stops you from starting with the last name on the list.

hosting.q: Where are candidate videos and data hosted?
hosting.a: Videos are hosted on our servers in France, and we use an AI hosted in France.

interview.a: A candidate who completes their session and whose report is generated. Invitations sent, abandoned sessions and your own tests never count. You can share your link as widely as you like.

quota.q: What happens when I exceed my plan?
quota.a: Nothing for your candidates: they're never blocked. On Plus and Pro, every interview beyond your plan is billed €4 and €3. On Pay as you go there is no plan: every interview costs €5.

trial.q: How do the 10 free interviews work?
trial.a: Your first 10 analyzed interviews are free, no credit card required, whichever plan you choose. After that, you automatically move to your plan's rate. You can add a payment method at any time.

billing.a: Monthly has no commitment: move up or down a plan whenever you want. Annual shows the reduced monthly price: Plus at €169/mo and Pro at €329/mo, billed once a year.
